_meta.source: Traditional palmistry — Hasta Samudrika Shastra (Vedic) and Western cheirology. For ENTERTAINMENT only; not scientific, not prediction, not medical/financial/legal advice.
_meta.how: Each observed feature is matched against quality rules; matched rules contribute a traditional 'is read as' statement plus optional strength/challenge/theme tags. Never asserts lifespan, illness, or fixed outcomes.

qualities.text: an upward-curving heart line is traditionally read as warm, openly expressive affection
a straighter heart line is read as steady, more private affection
a long heart line suggests generosity in love
a shorter heart line suggests keeping feelings close
a clear heart line is read as feeling things deeply
a faint heart line is read as guarding the heart
breaks are traditionally read as ups and downs in matters of the heart
a long head line is linked with thorough, wide-ranging thinking
a short head line is linked with quick, decisive thinking
a straight head line is read as practical, logical thinking
a sloping head line is read as imaginative, creative thinking
a clear head line suggests focus
a faint head line is read as a dreamy, wandering mind

life_line.domain: vitality and enthusiasm for life (never lifespan)

qualities.text: a broad, strong life line is read as vitality and enthusiasm — traditionally about energy, never length of life
a wide-sweeping life line is read as warmth and openness to experience
a lighter life line is read as pacing your energy (again, never lifespan)
breaks are read as chapters and fresh starts

fate_line.domain: direction, work and sense of path

qualities.text: a clear fate line is traditionally read as a strong sense of direction
a faint fate line is read as a self-made path, shaped by your own choices rather than a fixed track
a wavering fate line is read as a varied, winding path

sun_line.domain: creativity, expression and a little shine

qualities.text: a present sun line is traditionally linked with creativity and a natural bit of shine
a faint sun line is read as a quieter, still-emerging spark
